title: BUILD Edit Protocol v1 under the frozen V11 model regime
directive: Operator P1 launch directive: proceed to freeze after mechanical proof of twelve items; do NOT run a live model execution; no new token/reasoning experiments; no fuzzy matching or textual patch recovery.

model_regime_frozen.note: identical to V11 — the model configuration is NOT an experimental variable

treatment.name: BUILD publication protocol v1 (anchored semantic edits)
treatment.old: textual SLE-PATCH / model-authored unified diff (V8-V11 protocol)
treatment.new: structured build-changeset ActionContract: run-scoped opaque anchors minted by Stratum on read_source_slice (path + base sha + exact span + content hash); the model submits {edits:[{anchor_id,replacement}], creates:[{path,content}]} through the existing submit_result transport; Stratum re-verifies base hashes against disk, splices exact bytes, and publishes through the unchanged publication boundary; unified diffs exist only as Stratum-generated audit evidence

primary_hypothesis.statement: BUILD successfully stages and publishes its required authorized source edit in at least 2/3 evaluable BUILD opportunities.
primary_hypothesis.comparator: V11 (32k+low, old protocol): 0/3 BUILD publications; 6/6 real-output serialization failures across the config line
primary_hypothesis.decision_rule: SUPPORTED if >= 2/3 evaluable BUILD opportunities publish; FALSIFIED if < 2/3

secondary_outcome_taxonomy: submission failure: missing/malformed submit_result, schema or result-repair exhaustion
authority/staging rejection: editPolicy, required-path, create-exists, base-state or ownership rejection
downstream semantic failure: BUILD publication succeeds but EXEC/tests/validation fail
end-to-end success: BUILD publishes and the downstream workflow completes successfully

sampling_plan.stop_rule: stop after 3 evaluable BUILD opportunities or 9 evaluable workflows, whichever occurs first

capability_preflight.detail: BUILD effort 'low' and TEST effort 'low' are in the model's live declared supported_efforts ['max','high','low'] (default 'max'); live snapshot matches the V11 metadata snapshot

items.1_build_resolves_action_artifact: PASS — full-build BUILD step declares actionArtifact.type = build-changeset; application registry resolves it
items.2_schema_projection_golden: PASS — submit_result input_schema (both in code and on the wire, request 1) equals the frozen closed {edits, creates} schema; golden archived and hashed
items.3_investigation_tools: PASS — turn 1 tools exactly [read_file, read_source_slice, list_directory, submit_result] (AGENT_TOOLS + the submission channel, nothing else)
items.4_anchor_binding: PASS — read_source_slice result carries anchor {anchor_id, path, base_sha256=file bytes, start_line, end_line, content_sha256=span bytes}; id matches the frozen deterministic formula; a fresh registry cannot resolve it (run-scoped)
items.6_no_patch_teaching: PASS — zero SLE-PATCH/SLE-ARTIFACT/unified-diff/hunk tokens in everything BUILD sees (system + all messages, both turns)
items.7_fail_closed_anchors: PASS — unknown/cross-run/duplicate/overlapping/stale all rejected (validate or authoritative stage); disjoint anchors validate; identical bindings dedupe to one id and duplicate edits with it fail closed
items.8_create_no_overwrite: PASS — staging a create onto an existing path fails closed
items.9_staged_not_proposed: PASS — 9a: valid proposal without the required path fails the step (requiredEditPaths unsatisfied, base untouched); 9b: schema-valid proposal with a stale base fails authoritatively despite passing validate; no applied-edit provenance in either
items.10_staging_no_disk_mutation: PASS — full tree (sha + mtime) byte-identical across stage(); changeset is in-memory only; the publication boundary remains the sole writer
items.11_evidence_only: PASS — anchored modules import no diff applier and teach no SLE-PATCH syntax (comments excluded, verified); anchor manifest + Stratum-generated audit diff written post-publication under .sle/runs/.../node-outputs/ and never appear in anything the model sees
items.12_legacy_byte_identical: PASS — legacy non-action step: no submission tool offered, no anchor fields on read results, no anchored_edits, unchanged produced-file provenance, expected legacy bytes on disk

qualification_context.offline_tests: 24 new tests (17 unit + 7 runner-level) incl. campaign regression-impossibility pins; full suite 1838 pass / 0 fail at the freeze commit
qualification_context.replay_qualification: v9-1 and v9-3 archived model intents re-expressed as anchored proposals stage BYTE-IDENTICAL outputs (96,923 B sha 9d665a2248ee…; 96,325 B sha 0c247dd782be…); v11-3 SLE-ARTIFACT create staged byte-equal (2,530 B); v11-3's rejected patch diagnosed as fabricated old-side context — a class v1 makes unrepresentable (archive: evidence/v1-protocol-replay/)
